## Agent 2: research
Started by Agent 1 (POST /webhook/blog-agent-2, answers at once, 'accepted'). Fetches the source page, SerpApi (3 tries), and the top 3 results (2 tries each; failures skipped). Fails the run only if there is no research at all. Carries `run` (runId, mode, dryRun) to Agent 3.

**Dry run:** start from Agent 1 with `{"dryRun": true}`.
